run_create_views: run the script to pre-create all database views required by the LiteLLM Proxy Server
run_check_view_exists: run check_view_exists to verify and create missing database views for LiteLLM
create_verification_token_view: create the LiteLLM_VerificationTokenView that joins verification tokens with team spend and budget data
create_monthly_spend_views: create MonthlyGlobalSpend and MonthlyGlobalSpendPerKey views to track daily spend over the last 30 days
create_spend_analytics_views: create Last30dKeysBySpend, Last30dModelsBySpend, DailyTagSpend, and Last30dTopEndUsersSpend views for spend analytics
